title: Project workspace, versions, stems and storage

dependencies.canonicalExternalStorageAuthority: 420ResourceProtocol/420Store remains authoritative for its own agreements/proofs/object references

rules: failed/cancelled takes expire within seven days absent an explicit later save/hold policy
unsaved generated takes expire within thirty days
active private projects transition after 365 days inactivity
archive is a private thirty-day grace tier, not indefinite storage
export packages expire within twenty-four hours

authorityBoundaries: 420Hz owns only application-controlled private workspace state and its local deletion ledger
420ResourceProtocol/420Store retain authority over external storage agreements, proofs, placement and settlement
a project StorageObjectRef/integrity hash does not prove 420Hz can physically erase every external replica
private project deletion does not erase immutable Creative/chain provenance history
project favorites/selections are workspace preferences only and create no rights, payment, Charts or Awards authority
private projects, drafts, failed outputs and archives are never public Search/Indexer inputs
quota policy is deployment/application configuration and not a protocol constant
archive/export does not create public visibility or new rights
invariants: HZGCA5-001 every project is PRIVATE and non-indexable by default
HZGCA5-002 only the project owner may read or mutate workspace state
HZGCA5-003 project history is an immutable parent-linked version tree
HZGCA5-004 complete generation outputs preserve provider-neutral MIX/STEM/LYRICS_TIMING/ARTWORK manifests
HZGCA5-005 selected takes must be COMPLETE and contain a MIX
HZGCA5-006 failed/incomplete outputs cannot become selected or favorite takes
HZGCA5-007 stored private artifacts carry SHA-256 integrity commitments checked on read
HZGCA5-008 quota is preflighted before writes and quota exhaustion fails closed
HZGCA5-009 quota exhaustion never silently deletes saved work
HZGCA5-010 failed/cancelled take retention is bounded to seven days
HZGCA5-011 active project inactivity transitions after 365 days without becoming public
HZGCA5-012 archive grace is private and bounded to thirty days
HZGCA5-013 export packages are authenticated and expire within twenty-four hours
HZGCA5-014 explicit deletion revokes serving/indexing and tombstones application-controlled storage
HZGCA5-015 tombstones prevent replay/restore resurrection under the same storage identity
HZGCA5-016 storage integrity tampering fails closed
HZGCA5-017 private workspace state never feeds a public indexing projection
HZGCA5-018 workspace/storage behavior creates no new storage-provider, rights, payment, governance, Charts or Awards authority
limitations: deterministic private storage is repository/local qualification infrastructure, not a production 420Store deployment
no live Resource/Storage agreement, proof, placement or settlement is claimed
no live Search/Indexer endpoint is claimed; privacy is qualified by absence of public projection output
physical replica/backup deletion outside application control is not claimed
exitCriteria: favorite and selected takes are implemented
lyrics and metadata drafts are versioned
quota/resource accounting exists and fails closed
incomplete/failed output sets are safe and non-selectable
deterministic project state and storage integration tests pass on the exact implementation SHA
